title: Frequent Visit Points Bonus — Kessler Owner Rewards, Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
The visit bonus on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders paid repair order follows the account's payment history and tier.

| Payments received on the account within the last twelve whole months | Account tier | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| At least 3 | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 250 |
| At least 3 | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 100 |
| Fewer than 3, or any other tier | — | none |

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the crediting date, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on the crediting date count. Every payment received on the account counts, on any of its repair orders.

**Edges (hypothetical, crediting date 20 November).** A payment dated 21 November of the year before is inside the window (eleven whole months); one dated 20 November of the year before is outside it (twelve whole months).
